messages:
Nina Alvarez: Quick thread for today's all-hands 15 min tech run and live Q&A plan. Can everyone confirm availability?
Samir Desai: I'll be on the panel. Running late by 5 but ok for tech check.
Kai (AV): AV team on-site at 15:20 PT. Bringing spares: 3x HDMI, 2x DP, 4x lavs.
Lydia - PeopleOps: Agenda tweak request: move hiring update before product roadmap so folks on interviews can join late.
Nina Alvarez: OK shifting hiring update to 16:05 -> roadmap stays at 16:20. Q&A at 16:45.
Riley - Product: For Q&A voting, please :thumbsup: the pinned questions. We'll prioritize top 6.
Marta (Security): Heads-up: Private deploy slide must include KMS/HSM note and key rotation statement.
Kai (AV): Test note: if presenters lose video but audio continues, switch to "slides-only" scene to avoid black frame.
StreamBot: :warning: Ingest endpoint #3 latency spiked to 320ms 2m ago. Monitoring.
Kai (AV): If ingest degrades, fallback command for encoder:
```
# switch to backup endpoint
sed -i 's/rtmp:\/\/ingest1/rtmp:\/\/ingest-backup/' /etc/stream.conf && systemctl restart stream-encoder
```
Samir Desai: During rehearsals the Roomb mic dropped when someone stood 1.5m from lectern. Any suggestions?
Kai (AV): Increase gain on CH2 and enable AGC for lectern mic. We'll do a quick run.
Lydia - PeopleOps: Please remind speakers to keep slides >18pt and add alt text for key graphics.
Nina Alvarez: We'll post a slide checklist link in #announcements in 5.
Riley - Product: Quick live question from pre-submits: "Will Optimize show cost delta estimates per suggestion?"
Nina Alvarez: We'll ask leadership live; if not answered, Product will post detail in the follow-up doc.
Marta (Security): One security QA: does Private support rolling HSM key rotation with zero downtime? Need to confirm for SOC audit.
Nina Alvarez: Tagging security on stage; we'll cover briefly and follow up with an RFC link.
Kai (AV): OBS note: avoid scene transitions longer than 300ms. Otherwise captions may lag.
StreamBot: :white_check_mark: Recording scheduled 16:00 UTC. Auto-archive to /shared/all-hands/2026-06-10/.
Samir Desai: If recording fails, please at least capture transcript + slides.
Kai (AV): Fallback plan: if encoder crashes, we continue audio-only stream and push recording of audio + slides. Command to capture audio-only:
```
ffmpeg -f alsa -i default -i slides.mp4 -c:a aac -b:a 128k -c:v copy -f mp4 fallback_audio_slides.mp4
```
Lydia - PeopleOps: Also printing 2 hard copies of the agenda and the Q list for moderators.
Nina Alvarez: Thanks team. Last call for questions in this thread; we'll pull live and keep unanswered Qs for a follow-up doc.
Riley - Product: (live) Will also drop the quick product follow-up issues in #product after the call.
Kai (AV): Doing final audio sweep now. Levels at -6dB peak.
StreamBot: :recording: Recording started at 16:01:12 UTC.
Marta (Security): (post-meeting) FYI security will post the HSM key rotation RFC link within 24h.
Nina Alvarez: Closing thread  thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. If anything breaks, escalate in #eng-oncall. :clap:
